<reason>CON won by breaking the means-ends link: higher rates raise mortgages, push buyers into rentals, and stall construction while rents lag, so the demand effect is weakest where scarcity is worst. PRO's honest answer to prioritize - tighten further despite rising unemployment for only slower rent growth - let CON weigh certain job loss against speculative rent relief, leaving PRO's entrenchment and fairness points without a working tool.</reason>
